name: Custom Shape Wooden Key Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
  • Crafted from premium 5mm wood, this key holder is sturdy yet lightweight. Customers can choose between two structural options:

 - 1-Layer Option: Made from a single 5mm wood layer. Sleek, minimalistic, and perfect for those who prefer a simpler design while still enjoying high-quality UV printing.

 - 2-Layer Option: Built with two 5mm wooden layers for a total thickness of 10mm. The layered structure adds depth and a 3D effect to the design, offering a more dynamic and premium look.

  • Comes with durable metal hooks: Available in black or bronze, single or double type.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in a variety of sizes to suit different spaces and user needs:

 - 8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm – max 3 hooks

 - 10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm – max 4 hooks

 - 12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm – max 5 hooks

 - 12 x 6 inches ~ 30.48 x 15.24 cm – max 4 hooks

 - 16 x 8 inches ~ 40.64 x 20.32 cm – max 6 hooks

 - 24 x 8 inches ~ 60.96 x 20.32 cm – max 8 hooks

 

  • Printing Technology:

UV printing on front side only ensures vivid color, high-resolution images and text.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

Ideal for hanging: keys, dog leashes, and small accessories only.

Comes with pre-installed mounting hooks on the back for easy wall hanging.

Ideal for organizing entryways, mudrooms, or pet corners in a stylish and fun way.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

Whether you're shopping for a pet lover, new homeowner, friend, or family member, this key and leash holder is a thoughtful gift that combines personal touch with everyday utility.

Perfect for: Birthdays, Holidays (Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother’s/Father’s Day), Housewarmings, Pet adoption anniversaries, or just to treat yourself!

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape Wooden Key Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
